newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Jan C/A surplus FIM 0.5 billion -Cen Bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Jan C/A surplus FIM 0.5 billion -Cen Bank.

text.p: The Finnish current account surplus narrowed to 0.5 billion markka in January from a 2.0 billion surplus in December, but it was up on a 0.2 billion deficit in January 1996, the Bank of Finland said on Thursday.
It gave the following balance of payments (billion markka):
(* The Bank of Finland said a negative figure marks an increase in reserves).

Finland's net foreign debt was 270.4 billion markka at end-January, up from 246.2 billion at end-December 1996. The state's share of net foreign debt was 189.9 billion markka, up from 183.7 billion, the central bank said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
